meta_data.base_class: Advise on export regulations for shipping goods <from origin to destination> - each pair represents a unique combination of departure and destination countries, with no country appearing more than once across all pairs (e.g., if 'China to the USA' exists, 'Spain to China' cannot).
derived_classes: from Spain to the United Kingdom
from North Korea to the Philippines

tool_template.name: ExportRegulationAdvisor_<class>
tool_template.description: Advise on export regulations for shipping goods <class>.

export_category.description: The category of goods being exported.

include_legal_requirements.description: Whether to include legal requirements for export the goods <class>.

customs_clearance_requirements.description: Whether to include information on customs clearance requirements for shipping goods <class>.

transportation_modes.description: List of applicable modes of transportation for shipping goods <class>, such as 'air', 'sea', and 'land'.

tariff_information.description: Whether to include details on tariffs applicable to goods shipped <class>.

documentation_needed.description: Whether to include a list of necessary documentation for exporting goods <class>.

export_deadlines.description: Information on critical deadlines for shipping goods <class>, such as submission deadlines for required documents.
